# Claude SDLC: AI-Native Software Development Lifecycle for Claude Code

**15 role-based AI skills that give Claude Code a complete software development methodology** -- from project kickoff to production monitoring. Every SDLC phase, every team role, orchestrated by your AI agent.

> Built for [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code) (Anthropic's CLI agent). Works with the superpowers plugin, council multi-model skill, and Playwright MCP for autonomous browser testing.

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Claude Code](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20for-Claude%20Code-orange)](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code)
[![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/Skills-15%20SDLC%20Roles-green)](#skills-included)

---

## What Is This?

Claude SDLC is a **complete software development lifecycle methodology packaged as Claude Code skills**. Instead of treating AI as a code generator bolted on at the end, this system makes Claude a first-class team member in every development role:

- **Product Manager** -- writes PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and roadmaps
- **Solution Architect** -- designs systems, writes ADRs, defines API contracts
- **Tech Lead** -- breaks epics into tasks, enforces code standards, reviews PRs
- **Developer** -- implements features with clean code, TDD, and documentation
- **QA Engineer** -- creates test plans, writes test cases, files bug reports
- **And 10 more roles** covering DevOps, release management, incident response, UI/UX, and project management

Each role is a standalone skill file that Claude Code loads automatically when you describe what you need. Say "design the architecture for my new app" and Claude activates the Solution Architect skill. Say "fix this bug" and the Bug Fix skill takes over with root cause analysis, systematic debugging, and regression test requirements.

---

## Why Use This?

| Without Claude SDLC | With Claude SDLC |
|---|---|
| AI generates code with no process | AI follows a structured methodology across all phases |
| No architecture decisions documented | ADRs, API contracts, and data models produced automatically |
| Tests are an afterthought | Test-driven development enforced by the Developer skill |
| Bug fixes lack root cause analysis | 5-Whys RCA required, regression tests mandatory |
| Releases are ad-hoc | Release checklists, semantic versioning, and changelogs |
| Solo devs skip everything | Compressed solo-dev workflow preserves essential quality gates |
| AI approves its own work | Human gates enforced -- AI drafts, humans approve |

## How It Works: Skill Orchestration

Claude SDLC skills don't work in isolation. They orchestrate with **companion skills and MCP servers** to deliver a complete development workflow:

```
                         +------------------+
                         |   Your Prompt    |
                         +--------+---------+
                                  |
                    +-------------v--------------+
                    |   Claude Code Skill Engine  |
                    +-------------+--------------+
                                  |
              +-------------------+-------------------+
              |                   |                    |
    +---------v--------+ +-------v--------+ +---------v--------+
    |  SDLC Skills (15)|  | Superpowers    | | Council Skill    |
    |  (this repo)     |  | Plugin         | | (OpenRouter)     |
    +--------+---------+  +-------+--------+ +--------+---------+
             |                    |                    |
             |              Execution engine:    Multi-model AI:
             |              - TDD workflows      - GPT, Gemini,
             |              - Plan writing        DeepSeek opinions
             |              - Code review        - Architecture review
             |              - Debugging          - Market analysis
             |              - Verification       - Pricing strategy
             |                    |                    |
             +----------+---------+--------------------+
                        |
              +---------v----------+
              | MCP Tool Servers   |
              +--------------------+
              | Playwright MCP     | -- Browser automation, E2E testing,
              |                    |    screenshot capture, UI verification
              | Crypto.com MCP     | -- Market data (if building fintech)
              | Firebase MCP       | -- Firebase integration
              | Context7 MCP       | -- Library documentation lookup
              +--------------------+
```

### Orchestration Examples

**New Feature (end-to-end):**
```
1. project-kickoff  -->  brainstorming (superpowers)  -->  council fan-out (3 models)
2. product-manager  -->  PRD with acceptance criteria
3. solution-architect  -->  writing-plans (superpowers)  -->  council/architecture
4. tech-lead  -->  task breakdown
5. developer  -->  test-driven-development (superpowers)  -->  parallel agents
6. code-reviewer  -->  requesting-code-review (superpowers)
7. qa-engineer  -->  Playwright MCP (autonomous browser testing)
8. release-manager  -->  finishing-a-development-branch (superpowers)
```

**Bug Fix:**
```
1. bug-fix  -->  systematic-debugging (superpowers)  -->  council/bug_fix
2. developer  -->  test-driven-development (regression test first)
3. code-reviewer  -->  verification-before-completion (superpowers)
```

**Production Incident:**
```
1. incident-response  -->  systematic-debugging (superpowers)
2. Playwright MCP  -->  verify pages are loading
3. bug-fix  -->  hotfix branch  -->  expedited review
4. release-manager  -->  emergency deploy
```

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- **[Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code)** -- Anthropic's CLI agent (required)
- **Python 3.8+** -- for the setup script
- **Git** -- to clone this repo

### Quick Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/grandheman/claude-sdlc.git
cd claude-sdlc
python setup.py
```

The setup script copies all 15 skill files into your `~/.claude/skills/` directory where Claude Code discovers them automatically.

### Manual Install

If you prefer to install manually, copy the skill folders from `skills/` into `~/.claude/skills/`:

```bash
cp -r skills/* ~/.claude/skills/
cp SDLC-METHODOLOGY.md ~/.claude/
cp SKILLS-INDEX.md ~/.claude/
```

### Verify Installation

After installing, start Claude Code and ask:
```
"What SDLC skills are available?"
```

Claude should list all 15 skills and explain when each one triggers.

---

## Companion Skills & Requirements

### Superpowers Plugin (Recommended)

The superpowers plugin provides the **execution engine** that SDLC skills rely on for TDD, plan writing, code review, debugging, and verification workflows.

- **What it does:** Adds `brainstorming`, `writing-plans`, `executing-plans`, `test-driven-development`, `systematic-debugging`, `requesting-code-review`, `verification-before-completion`, and more
- **Install:** Available as a Claude Code plugin. Search for "superpowers" in Claude Code plugin marketplace.

### Council Skill (Recommended -- Requires OpenRouter API Key)

The council skill queries **multiple AI models** (GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, etc.) via [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/) for second opinions on architecture, debugging, market analysis, and pricing.

> **You need your own [OpenRouter API key](https://openrouter.ai/keys) to use the council skill.** OpenRouter provides access to 100+ AI models with a single API key. Set it as `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` in your environment.

- **What it does:** Fan-out queries to 3+ models for architecture reviews, market viability, debugging second opinions, pricing strategy
- **Install:**
  ```bash
  git clone https://github.com/grandheman/claude-council.git
  cd claude-council
  python setup.py
  ```
- **Configure:** Set your OpenRouter API key:
  ```bash
  # Add to your shell profile (.bashrc, .zshrc, etc.)
  export OPENROUTER_[REDACTED-GENERIC_KV_SECRET]"
  ```

### Playwright MCP (Recommended)

Enables **autonomous browser testing** -- Claude can navigate pages, fill forms, click buttons, take screenshots, and read console errors without any manual browser interaction.

- **What it does:** E2E test execution, bug reproduction in-browser, UI verification, screenshot evidence capture
- **Install:** Add the Playwright MCP plugin to Claude Code, then:
  ```bash
  npx playwright install
  ```

### Simplify Skill (Optional)

After completing any task, the `simplify` skill reviews changed code for reuse opportunities, quality issues, and efficiency improvements.

- **Install:** Available as a Claude Code plugin. Search for "simplify" or included in the superpowers plugin.

---

## Solo Developer Mode

You don't need a team to use this. The methodology includes a **compressed solo-dev workflow** that preserves essential quality gates while cutting ceremony:

```
1. Brief PRD (product-manager skill) -- 30 min, not 3 days
2. Quick architecture sketch (solution-architect) -- ADR for key decisions
3. Task breakdown (tech-lead) -- just a checklist
4. TDD implementation (developer + test-driven-development)
5. Self-review + simplify (code-reviewer + simplify)
6. Ship (release-manager -- version bump + brief changelog)
```

**What AI replaces for you (solo):**
- `/council` fan-out replaces "ask a colleague" for architecture and business decisions
- `requesting-code-review` replaces peer review
- `qa-engineer` generates test plans you wouldn't write yourself
- `systematic-debugging` replaces rubber duck debugging

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I need Claude Code to use this?
**Yes.** These skills are designed specifically for [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code), Anthropic's CLI agent. The skill files use Claude Code's SKILL.md format and are loaded by Claude Code's skill discovery system.

### Do I need an OpenRouter API key?
**Only for the council skill** (multi-model second opinions). The 15 core SDLC skills work without it. If you want architecture reviews, market analysis, or debugging opinions from GPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek, you'll need a free or paid key from [openrouter.ai](https://openrouter.ai/).

### Does this work with other AI coding tools?
The methodology document (`SDLC-METHODOLOGY.md`) is universal and can guide any AI-assisted development workflow. The skill files themselves (`.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md`) are specific to Claude Code's skill format.

### Is this opinionated?
Yes. This methodology enforces:
- Test-driven development (write failing test first)
- Architecture Decision Records for every major decision
- Human gates on production deploys, PRD sign-off, and code review approval
- Root cause analysis for every bug (no "fix and forget")
- Semantic versioning and release notes for every release

### Can I customize the skills?
Absolutely. After installation, the skill files live in your `~/.claude/skills/` directory. Edit any SKILL.md to adjust the process to your team's needs.

### How is this different from just prompting Claude?
Prompting is ad-hoc. Skills are **persistent, structured, and composable**. Each skill:
- Triggers automatically based on what you're doing
- Enforces checklists and quality gates
- Chains with companion skills (superpowers, council, Playwright)
- Produces consistent output formats (ADRs, PRDs, test plans, release notes)
- Maintains human-in-the-loop gates where they matter
